cards.title: Feasibility of headless execution and a real Scala REPL
cards.behavior: Minimal reproducer: val/def/case class bindings, a shared runtime object through a classloader/prelude bridge, background fibers, JLine edit buffer, bundled headless invocation. Check Scala/JDK/ZIO/artifacts and HTTP/schema candidates; record exact versions, startup/memory, and the recommended adapter.

acceptance.normal: SPIKE-01: clean startup, saved transcript and version inventory; separate headless process without terminal/compiler classpath.
acceptance.error: SPIKE-02: compile error preserves the previous binding; missing toolchain/artifact is explicitly unavailable.
acceptance.concurrency: SPIKE-03: Ctrl+C during foreground/await/idle and runner SIGTERM leave no orphan; background output does not corrupt the input line.

cards.non_goals: Production runtime, fake Scala parser, promise of a stable bind API; this prototype is not a release.

cards.title: Frozen public APIs and versioned schemas
cards.behavior: Compile-only Program/Agent/Workflow/Task/Job/Child, launch facade capability, all overloads, pipeline/verify/check codecs, backend events/errors. JSON schemas for input/context/run/result/bundle/checks. DefinitionContext is explicitly supplied by the REPL/loader; no global launch in imports.

acceptance.normal: API-01: positive Scala fixtures for apply/andThen/all heterogeneous tuple/map/for/fork/pipeline; canonical schema roundtrip.
acceptance.error: API-02: negative fixtures for wrong input/mixed Programs/Task output/unknown schema version; error family with stable exit mapping.
acceptance.concurrency: API-03: construction/printer does not execute the backend; immutable descriptors can be shared without runtime mutation.

cards.non_goals: Working transports/REPL, Any/casts at the public boundary, second DSL parser.

cards.title: Pinned build and distribution separation
cards.behavior: Canonical sbt multi-project, exact tool versions, JDK policy, dependency resolution, and build inventory. Run/dev module dependency graph: core does not know about the compiler; testkit is outside production. Bootstrap is not hidden inside tests.

acceptance.normal: BUILD-01: clean compile of all skeleton modules; dependency tree and headless distribution exclude compiler/JLine.
acceptance.error: BUILD-02: unsupported JDK/missing tool is reported before the build; no floating versions/snapshots.
acceptance.concurrency: BUILD-03: two independent clean builds produce the same dependency inventory; the build does not launch models/tools.

cards.non_goals: Full packaging/release, auto-install during a quality gate.

cards.title: Quality runner, classifier, and evidence
cards.behavior: Protected argv registry, diff classifier for merge-base/staged/unstaged/untracked/rename/delete/unborn, required profiles, timeout/partial logs, source/policy/toolchain/log hashes. evidence --require checks freshness/completeness, not the author's summary.

acceptance.normal: GATE-01: fast/changed/full and profile commands generate a valid manifest; selected risky paths include the correct profiles.
acceptance.error: GATE-02: fabricated/stale log, missing tool, skipped gate, changed threshold/registry, and evidence write failure return nonzero.
acceptance.concurrency: GATE-03: timeout/SIGTERM preserves a partial report, concurrent source edit invalidates the run; gates do not rewrite source.

cards.non_goals: Weakening coverage/thresholds, paid inference, using shell for registry argv.

cards.title: Profiles, policies, and independent provider configuration
cards.behavior: Versioned immutable configuration, environment-based credential references, model roles, explicit defaults, endpoint/auth/version normalization, runtime ceilings, and trust ownership. OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, and Yabanin are available on equal terms; prices are nullable and their source is known.

acceptance.normal: CFG-01: three profiles and mixed-role resolution without service calls, with the API prefix preserved; bounded environment credential resolution.
acceptance.error: CFG-02: missing role/key, duplicate names, insecure remote URL, invalid cap, and unknown required option are rejected before dispatch; diagnostics are redacted.
acceptance.concurrency: CFG-03: a running snapshot does not change on reload; overrides only narrow capabilities/ceilings.

cards.non_goals: HTTP calls, literal secrets, implicit gateway/direct failover, minting keys.

cards.title: Deterministic testkit without an LLM
cards.behavior: Scripted ModelBackend/tool outcomes, virtual time, controllable promises/barriers, request recorder, simulated usage/errors/partial events. Fixture mode is labeled; core contract suites are reusable with any backend.

acceptance.normal: MOCK-01: text/tool/tool-result/final, scripted price/unknown usage, and ordered event traces.
acceptance.error: MOCK-02: invalid fixture, unexpected call, overread, or output bound do not turn into success.
acceptance.concurrency: MOCK-03: virtual deadline/backoff and controllable cancellation/finish races without real sleeps.

cards.non_goals: Network client, mixing mock and live modes, testkit dependency on the production classpath.

cards.title: Job registry and atomic lifecycle
cards.behavior: Typed Job handle, heterogeneous admin views only through codecs, IDs/root lineage, queued/running/waiting/terminal transitions, shared completion, and bounded retention. Admission remains a separate service.

acceptance.normal: JOB-01: start/read/await terminal outcome; two awaits do not repeat the backend call; multiple roots are independent.
acceptance.error: JOB-02: unknown ID, invalid transition, or duplicate terminal event produce typed errors/late observations.
acceptance.concurrency: JOB-03: many waiters plus a cancel/success race yield one terminal winner/result, with no lost waiter.

cards.non_goals: Database/daemon, an unbounded forever registry, cost/tool implementation.

cards.title: Structured scopes and subtree cancellation
cards.behavior: CI/REPL owner→root→scoped child, cancellation-safe registration/finalizers, bounded cleanup, and no new dispatch after Cancelling. Domain failure and interruption are distinguishable.

acceptance.normal: SCOPE-01: join/scoped exit/all-fail cancel unjoined children; the root completes after mandatory finalizers.
acceptance.error: SCOPE-02: cleanup failure/grace exhaustion is reflected as Interrupted/Uncertain according to evidence, not fake Cancelled.
acceptance.concurrency: SCOPE-03: interrupt exactly between child launch/register; no orphan, one completion, and permit cleanup.

cards.non_goals: Detached daemon jobs, Future/Await/global runtime, promise of remote cancellation on TCP close.

cards.title: Root budget and deadlock-free admission
cards.behavior: Atomic exact-money ledger/reservations/settlement, attempts/tokens/depth/children/queue/model/tool ceilings. Unknown price is explicit; retries and output repair consume the root cap. Fair bounded queues and deadline while waiting.

acceptance.normal: BUD-01: concurrent child totals <= declared bounded admission; exact rounding/overflow; mixed-provider root.
acceptance.error: BUD-02: unknown price with a required hard USD cap is rejected; negative/overflow configuration does not start.
acceptance.concurrency: BUD-03: parent delegate+join with model slots=1 does not deadlock; cancellation at every acquisition boundary releases correctly.

cards.non_goals: Pipeline-wide distributed hard cap, Double money, post-hoc polling as admission.

cards.title: Native agent loop
cards.behavior: Freeze profile/tools/model/context; normalize requests/events; validate tool arguments and policy; bound retries/steps; validate final output. Runnable delegate primitive after limits; LLM-driven profile selection uses a checked registry.

acceptance.normal: LOOP-01: text→tool→result→final and child delegation with scoped ownership; attempt/ToolCall IDs are preserved.
acceptance.error: LOOP-02: invalid arguments/schema/unknown tool/profile, provider error, and max steps/depth are rejected without side effects.
acceptance.concurrency: LOOP-03: cancellation during stream/tool/join; partial tool arguments are not executed; retries are bounded and billed attempts are distinct.

cards.non_goals: Compaction/full typed repair, external engines as the sole runtime, trusted verdict from the model response.

cards.title: OpenAI-compatible HTTP Chat
cards.behavior: Nonstreaming Chat serialization/auth/tool rounds/errors/usage, API prefix/TLS/redirect behavior, bounded body/timeouts. The endpoint model is configured without requiring `/models`; normalize actual versus requested metadata.

acceptance.normal: CHAT-01: a real local HTTP mock accepts the request/tool IDs and returns text/tool/usage outcomes without Yabanin.
acceptance.error: CHAT-02: 401/403/429/5xx/malformed/oversize/unsupported-required are classified; auth is not sent to another origin.
acceptance.concurrency: CHAT-03: cancelling the request/body closes resources; ambiguous paid attempts do not zero usage or repeat tools.

cards.non_goals: Responses, Azure/cloud auth ecosystem, gateway-specific headers in the generic adapter.

cards.title: OpenAI SSE streaming state machine
cards.behavior: Incremental UTF-8/SSE framing and normalized deltas, interleaved tool indices/arguments, usage-only data, and finish_reason/DONE/EOF policy. Anthropic may reuse the framing; its semantic parser remains separate.

acceptance.normal: SSE-01: all chunk partitions of the sanitized corpus produce identical output/usage/tool IDs.
acceptance.error: SSE-02: truncated frames/oversize/invalid JSON/EOF-before-finish/idle timeout produce typed failures, with no partial tool execution.
acceptance.concurrency: SSE-03: slow consumer/cancel/finish race uses bounded buffers, closes the response, and reports truthful accounting.

cards.non_goals: Assume one chunk=one event, unbounded concatenation, rewriting protocol fixtures to fit the parser.

cards.title: Anthropic-compatible Messages and streaming
cards.behavior: Independent Messages wire: system/content blocks/tool_use/tool_result, max_tokens/auth/version, indexed SSE block lifecycle/partial JSON/cumulative usage. Capability-specific metadata roundtrip and privacy without fake OpenAI conversion.

acceptance.normal: ANTH-01: local HTTP full tool round and text stream, equivalent native outcome without Yabanin env; multiple tools/errors.
acceptance.error: ANTH-02: refusal/truncation/error-after-200/unknown required block/incomplete stream/version-auth mismatch produce truthful errors.
acceptance.concurrency: ANTH-03: fragmented UTF-8/tool input and cancel between block_stop/message_stop; execute each tool once and do not sum cumulative usage twice.

cards.non_goals: Server-managed tools/cloud adapters/all beta features, logging thinking/signatures, silently dropped unsupported semantics.

cards.title: Reading and search with workspace containment
cards.behavior: Bounded read/search, realpath/workspace policy, UTF-8/binary behavior, and output truncation evidence. Do not use shell concatenation for search. File artifacts include provenance/hash.

acceptance.normal: READ-01: temporary repo read/search returns correct ranges and a bounded result; empty query/file behavior is defined.
acceptance.error: READ-02: traversal/symlink escape/permission/binary/oversize is rejected or explicitly truncated without a secret dump.
acceptance.concurrency: READ-03: a deleted/changed file during read gets a defined error/provenance; cancellation stops long search.

cards.non_goals: Write/process tools, a promise of a complete OS sandbox.

cards.title: Safe mutation and patch artifacts
cards.behavior: Expected SHA/content preconditions, atomic replace, diff bounds/encoding, symlink-aware write policy, patch/baseSha artifact. Writers are serialized by default; parallel agents use explicit isolated worktrees.

acceptance.normal: EDIT-01: apply the approved patch only when the base matches; record the resulting hash/diff, with no unrelated paths.
acceptance.error: EDIT-02: stale expected hash/path escape/protected verifier/invalid diff fail without partial silent mutation.
acceptance.concurrency: EDIT-03: stale conflict between two writers is predictable; cancellation before/during commit records applied/uncertain status.

cards.non_goals: Auto commit/push/merge, exactly-once after crash, changing the verifier in the agent workspace.

cards.title: Owned process tools and isolated execution
cards.behavior: Structured argv/cwd/env allowlist, output/time bounds, process groups/grace escalation, and sandbox capability negotiation. CI untrusted tests run only in a credential-free isolated worker; unavailable isolation means deny.

acceptance.normal: PROC-01: registered command fixture in a temp workspace, captured exit/output, and no inherited credentials.
acceptance.error: PROC-02: invalid argv/cwd/policy/missing sandbox/oversize/timeouts fail honestly; no raw shell interpolation.
acceptance.concurrency: PROC-03: SIGTERM/cancel kills owned grandchildren; PID reuse/foreign processes are not killed; unresolved remote processes are Uncertain.

cards.non_goals: Docker daemon setup, privileged mounts, a host sandbox guarantee from env filtering alone.

cards.title: Unified typed composition
cards.behavior: andThen/mapOutput, all Programs/Tasks arity2 typed tuples, ordered bounded batch/batchCollect, scope/fork/join. One effect interpreter; external cancellation is not swallowed by collect.

acceptance.normal: COMP-01: mixed typed tuple, sequential ordering, ordered batch, empty batch with no dispatch, and explicit input contexts.
acceptance.error: COMP-02: negative inference fixtures/mismatched inputs/invalid parallelism; fail-fast cancels siblings.
acceptance.concurrency: COMP-03: bounded fanout/root ledger and scope exit; with max model permit1, a waiting parent does not deadlock.

cards.non_goals: Macros, dynamic List[Any], race/quorum before P2, a separate scheduler.

cards.title: Ergonomic REPL launch facade
cards.behavior: ask/start/run/await/send/cancel/watch/info on Program/Task/Job through using ReplSession; method/infix/functional aliases delegate to one launch. Foreground/root observer cancellation ownership is explicit.

acceptance.normal: FACADE-01: primary DSL fixtures return a typed result/Job; repeated await makes no calls; prelude first answer.
acceptance.error: FACADE-02: missing session and blocking facade inside a workflow give clear errors; bare Task never runs.
acceptance.concurrency: FACADE-03: CtrlC has different behavior for a foreground subtree and an await/watch observer; session close owns roots.

cards.non_goals: Hidden global runtime, changing apply eager semantics, arbitrary persistent closures.

cards.title: Pinned compiler/JLine REPL adapter
cards.behavior: Real Scala evaluation/completion/multiline input, shared type/classloader context, single terminal writer/coalescing, session lifecycle/signal ownership. Compiler imports only the engine adapter; state reset is explicit.

acceptance.normal: REPL-01: val/def/case class/import/Unicode/load, old bindings survive a compile error and no output duplication.
acceptance.error: REPL-02: runtime error/EOF/bad pasted source restores the prompt; pretty-printing secrets/tasks is safe.
acceptance.concurrency: REPL-03: 20 streaming jobs while editing the buffer; CtrlC modes; reset/exit leave no orphan/fiber; actual process under PTY.

cards.non_goals: Fake Interpreter acceptance, Windows support without a suite, compiler in headless distribution.

cards.title: Prelude, registry commands and definition loading
cards.behavior: Presets, help/jobs/watch/cancel/agents/tools/workflows/load/run/spawn/doctor/reset/exit. DefinitionContext+explicit register/version snapshot; quoted paths parsed without a shell. Load trusted code without command-history replay.

acceptance.normal: CMD-01: help alone enables seven UX scenarios; load/register/run use the same Program and preview IDs.
acceptance.error: CMD-02: unknown ID/workflow/wrong input/bad path/code reports line+column; previous definitions are retained.
acceptance.concurrency: CMD-03: reload while running leaves the old snapshot pinned; exit/reset handles jobs, inbox/watch subscriptions.

cards.non_goals: Interactive prompt in CI, binary plugin hot reload, fabricated built-in upstream parity.

cards.title: Steering mailbox and checked model delegation
cards.behavior: Bounded ordered steering receipts queued/applied/rejected with consumption at safe boundaries. Delegate registered profile/version/schema/context/capability subset; join releases the active model permit.

acceptance.normal: MSG-01: send affects the next turn; model delegate child inherits RootId/policy/limits, typed outcome reference.
acceptance.error: MSG-02: finished job/full inbox/unauthorized profile/wrong child input/depth cap is rejected with a receipt.
acceptance.concurrency: MSG-03: send/cancel/finish race loses no receipt; recursive delegation stops admission; parent cancellation owns child.

cards.non_goals: Unbounded freeform cross-root bus, daemon messaging, passing parent credentials/full transcript by default.

cards.title: Compiled bundles and headless Runner
cards.behavior: Compile trusted definitions/registers→versioned JAR manifest; headless load validated bundle/input/workflow and run the same Task. Dev source shorthand requires explicit compilation; stdout JSON/noANSI, stderr diagnostics, no stdin dependence.

acceptance.normal: RUN-01: packaged runner executes mock Program from bundle with closed stdin, no compiler/JLine/network resolution.
acceptance.error: RUN-02: bad hash/API/dependency/schema/name/input fails preflight before spend; output failure is typed.
acceptance.concurrency: RUN-03: invocation owns root cleanup; bounded stop on SIGTERM; concurrent invocations have separate state directories.

cards.non_goals: Trust from bare hash, executing fork-supplied bundle with credentials, second interpreter/runtime.

cards.title: CI context and trust preflight
cards.behavior: Generic schema plus GitHub/GitLab env adapters, provenance/bounded metadata/matrix/retry identity and explicit owner trust. Protected bundle/verifier/policy sources are independent of the target workspace. Required policy is checked before dispatch.

acceptance.normal: CTX-01: same semantics from equivalent three contexts; fresh roots and stable logical identity.
acceptance.error: CTX-02: ambiguous auto platform/malformed missing context/untrusted trust escalation fails; no raw env export.
acceptance.concurrency: CTX-03: concurrent matrix/retry have distinct attribution; fork config cannot widen permissions or access keys.

cards.non_goals: CI DAG/runner scheduling, network repo hosting API calls, trusting env flag alone.

cards.title: Trusted checks, artifacts and exit contracts
cards.behavior: MVP deterministic verifier/check registry outside agent workspace, report-format/input/output schema checks; frozen advisory/blocking policy. Atomic run/result/events/JUnit/summary/artifacts manifests and stable error precedence; actual check evidence.

acceptance.normal: REPORT-01: success/finding advisory/blocking failure → expected run verdict/exit; hashes/XML match actual outputs.
acceptance.error: REPORT-02: diskfull/permission/secret/log-command/XML/path injection; every exit mapping table-driven including uncertainty.
acceptance.concurrency: REPORT-03: signal finalization during output writing preserves truthful partial state; no fake passed checks from model.

cards.non_goals: Task eval benchmark suite (041), SARIF publisher/PR writes, self-hash recursive manifest, green on reporter error.

cards.title: GitHub/GitLab/generic wrappers
cards.behavior: Thin templates for CLI+safe summary/scalar outputs+artifact upload/JUnit mapping; pinned third-party refs. Generic context example works without host vendor SDK. Default permissions/read-only/fork mock; paid/live/publish explicit.

acceptance.normal: PLAT-01: local env/template/schema fixtures; clean hosted runner transcripts when owner has configured infrastructure.
acceptance.error: PLAT-02: untrusted multiline summary/output/::command/PR title is not executed, no secret dotenv; missing hosted run stays pending.
acceptance.concurrency: PLAT-03: matrix identities/interruptible/retry preserve truthful artifacts and avoid blind mutation replay.

cards.non_goals: Universal cloud orchestrator, auto configure repo secrets, publication/posts, claiming readiness from YAML alone.

cards.title: Joint MVP acceptance
cards.behavior: One deterministic vertical slice: review/advisory, patch+checks, research output; same workflow in CI/REPL, standalone both wires, mixed providers. Acceptance matrix explicitly exports limits/cancel/error/artifact/trust.

acceptance.normal: MVP-01: product CLI and PTY transcripts pass; generic/GitHub/GitLab fixture semantic equivalence, no Yabanin dependency.
acceptance.error: MVP-02: missing creds/unsupported tools/invalid output/provider error/budget/deadline/check failure/report failure is nonzero.
acceptance.concurrency: MVP-03: two async children+steering+join/cancel; maxLLM1; SIGTERM owned process cleanup and no leak.

cards.non_goals: Live spend, asserting hosted CI without evidence, beta/P2 features; unresolved defect gets a dedicated fix card.

cards.title: Journal and Archival Without Replay
cards.behavior: Versioned event envelope, single writer/atomic snapshots, root sequences, bounded retention/redaction, archived views. Recovery invalid tail: interrupted/uncertain, no auto replay mutation/closure.

acceptance.normal: JOURNAL-01: events/results roundtrip and root/job lineage; archive available after restart.
acceptance.error: JOURNAL-02: corrupt tail/unknown schema/disk error marked incomplete; raw keys/prompts absent per policy.
acceptance.concurrency: JOURNAL-03: slow writer observer does not block the budget; bounded overflow defined, final flush errors honest.

cards.non_goals: Arbitrary Scala durable resume, SQL persistence without measurements, fake durability guarantees when events are dropped.

cards.title: Typed agents, tools, and bounded output repair
cards.behavior: Tool[I,O] and Agent[I,O] with shared codec/schema derivation, structured outputs, and runtime validation; beta support for all arities 3/4 with heterogeneous tuple inference. Endpoint native schema mode is optional; bounded repair attempts are charged; derive macro uses only the standard typeclass mechanism, not a compiler AST DSL.

acceptance.normal: TYPE-01: case class/enum/nested codec tests, typed chain inference, tool inputs roundtrip over both wires.
acceptance.error: TYPE-02: invalid JSON/unknown required field/schema mismatch/unsupported native capability, no unchecked casting.
acceptance.concurrency: TYPE-03: repair retry cap and root reservation with cancellation/deadline; repeated bad output ends Failed.

cards.non_goals: General schema framework from scratch, unlimited model repair, research verdict from an LLM.

cards.title: Definition Loaders and Context Policy
cards.behavior: Native Markdown/TOML/Scala definitions, provenance/version snapshot, instructions hierarchy/cwd/context policy, bounded resource refs. Reuse DefinitionContext; policy intersection, missing references typed.

acceptance.normal: LOAD-01: equivalent native profile definitions and source hashes, versioned registry roundtrip.
acceptance.error: LOAD-02: malformed frontmatter/unsupported required key/traversal/context secret leakage denied.
acceptance.concurrency: LOAD-03: reload affects new roots only; child TaskOnly vs Summary/Artifacts limits explicit.

cards.non_goals: Upstream importer semantics (032/033), executing untrusted Scala plugin, auto replay history.

cards.title: Context Limits and Compaction
cards.behavior: Model context capability/estimate, pinned instruction/task/tool history, artifact refs, explicit compaction checkpoint. Summary cost charged; preserve tool correlation and unsent steering; uncertain token estimate visible.

acceptance.normal: CTXMEM-01: long scripted conversation bounded, preserves task/tools/results needed for next request.
acceptance.error: CTXMEM-02: missing tokenizer/context size/compaction invalid/schema errors fail by policy, not silent truncation essentials.
acceptance.concurrency: CTXMEM-03: compaction vs steering/cancel race deterministic; job version/model role retained.

cards.non_goals: Magic infinite memory, embedding/vector DB/RAG platform, summary as task verifier.

cards.title: Versioned JVM plugin SPI
cards.behavior: Manifest/API range/IDs/dependencies/tools/providers/agents/middleware permissions. Immutable registry, deterministic hook order, scoped lifecycle; plugin code trusted with process authority. Invalid compatibility blocks load.

acceptance.normal: EXT-01: external example plugin registers typed tool+profile/provider via public SPI; no core changes.
acceptance.error: EXT-02: duplicate ID/API mismatch/cyclic deps/hook timeout/prohibited capability fail preflight.
acceptance.concurrency: EXT-03: hook failure cannot bypass root ceiling/cancel; concurrent jobs use pinned registry.

cards.non_goals: Sandboxing arbitrary JVM code, TS plugin interpreter, runtime binary hot reload, marketplace.

cards.title: Pi Profile Importer with Provenance
cards.behavior: Pin upstream commit/license/hash, import example scout/planner/reviewer/worker prompts+supported tool/context semantics into Raider profiles; compatibility report exact supported/ignored/rejected fields.

acceptance.normal: PIIMP-01: golden upstream corpus maps profiles/tool policies and notices reproducibly.
acceptance.error: PIIMP-02: unknown required tools/extensions/config rejected or explicit degraded opt-in, no false parity.
acceptance.concurrency: PIIMP-03: reloading an imported snapshot does not mutate running child policy; effective capabilities only narrow.

cards.non_goals: Copying the entire architecture, claiming built-in pi subagents, executing TS extensions on the JVM.

cards.title: OpenCode Profile Importer
cards.behavior: Pin upstream version/commit; Markdown/JSON profiles together with registry permissions/mode defaults, primary build/plan, and subagent roles for the actual version. Ask/deny/allow fidelity and unsupported permission patterns report.

acceptance.normal: OCIMP-01: golden prompts+policy profile corpus and license notices, requested permissions mapped.
acceptance.error: OCIMP-02: unsupported tool/wildcard/mode/ask-in-CI cannot silently become allow.
acceptance.concurrency: OCIMP-03: native parent policy intersects imported child; registry versions immutable.

cards.non_goals: All OpenCode config ecosystem/native TS plugins, carry prompts without permission semantics.

cards.title: Pi RPC external backend
cards.behavior: Owned pinned pi process, JSONL stdin/stdout protocol, stderr separate, LF framing, request IDs; acceptance vs actual agent_settled completion. capabilities tools/cancel/nested accounting accurately advertised.

acceptance.error: PIRPC-02: accepted prompt not treated final, stdout noise/corrupt JSON/crash/version mismatch fail.
acceptance.concurrency: PIRPC-03: Unicode separators are data; retry events not early-complete; process cancel acknowledgement/uncertainty truthful.

cards.title: OpenCode HTTP external backend

acceptance.error: OCBACK-02: auth/version/session mismatch/disconnect fail honest; unknown required guarantee blocks launch.
acceptance.concurrency: OCBACK-03: concurrent session events from two roots do not mix; abort ack vs requested abort different outcomes.

cards.behavior: Conversation implements Program, apply lazy, ask/start same verbs; bounded ordered turns, durable archive codec, X-Session-ID scope independent child histories. close and queued-turn cancellation defined.

acceptance.error: SESSION-02: closed/unknown/schema-invalid session and oversize history errors, no implicit agent restart.
acceptance.concurrency: SESSION-03: concurrent start/close/cancel/steering preserve order and root ownership; no dropped queued receipts.

cards.title: :type PTY oracles — remove echo saturation and use an honest error prefix
cards.behavior: RAI-124 review findings (2 minor + 1 risk): (1) TypeCommandsPtySpec bindingType=waitFor("Long") and jobType=waitFor("JobHandle[String]") are pre-saturated by echoes from previous steps (val counter: Long = 7 / val j: JobHandle[String]); the oracle therefore does not catch the regression “:type did not work.” Fix: check the response only AFTER sending :type (transcript position / unique sentinel via a preceding val with an unused name); a negative control is mandatory. (2) :type type errors are printed with the misleading prefix “command failed (prelude broken?)” (Commands.scala:116-118); replace it with honest diagnostic text for type queries, without changing the existing semantics of other commands.

acceptance.normal: TYPED-01: Negative control — with :type submission disabled, the oracles fail; with it enabled, they pass (proof that the oracle is not tautological).
acceptance.error: TYPED-02: A :type type error shows the compiler diagnostic without the misleading prelude prefix; existing Commands specs pass.
acceptance.concurrency: TYPED-03: TypeCommandsPtySpec ×3, flake=0; raiderRepl/test passes.

cards.non_goals: Compiler layer, new commands (:kind/:doc), chat module, or weakening the existing TYPE-01..03 oracles.
